verified_facts: VAE RGB/CoC encoding and overlap+temporal VAE decoding account for80.3612% of the instrumented4090D Core; old PRO6000 profile was81.0144%. Both support VAE-first diagnostic priority.

Per25 emitted frames, native RGB/CoC encoders and CLIP visit48 slots; temporal VAE actually decodes32 slots. Counts include overlapping context and three padded slots.
All five native stage times are higher on4090D than in old PRO6000 profile. Cache sizes, shapes, precision and stage allocated peaks remain close; device results are labeled separately.
